title.narrative: EU progressive Platforms for Climate Action

description.narrative: A new phase of the UNDP Funded EU Progressive Platforms program CAI01-E1 has been lauched by the UNDP. An Expression of Interest and Budget have been developed, attached here for review and approval to submit to UNDP May 2 or latest May 3 AM CET. The budget ceiling is USD 200K. It has been agreed with the donor to submit a simplified budget at this stage to be further refined through a workplanning process in June. The program has 2 outcomes: 1) Support to the LDC Chair and Membres in UNFCCC processes; 2) Capacity building in LDCS on NDC implementation.
